rationale: Late-exponential amino acid fermentation phase. Uptaking branched-chain and polar amino acids (arginine, proline, serine) for both carbon and nitrogen, supplemented with acetate uptake to manage accumulation. Fermentation yields acetate, propionate, butyrate, formate, and CO₂ as end products with excess ammonia release. Carbon and nitrogen budgets balance; growth rate supported by net 20 mmol C/gDW/h available after fermentation losses.
